name: loto-08: The day crew removes all of its tags at  / The night crew removes the last day-crew
view_a: The day crew removes all of its tags at the end of its shift.
view_b: The night crew removes the last day-crew tag after its own walkdown.
reconciled_statement: The crew that performs the walkdown removes the last tag and records the hand-off.

name: loto-02: Operators are notified before the machin / Operators are notified only once shutdow
view_a: Operators are notified before the machine is shut down.
view_b: Operators are notified only once shutdown starts, so the line is not stopped early.
